title: Claude and game design taste
author: oadephon
selftext:
Has anybody else noticed that Opus 5.5 is much better at game design suggestions than previous Claude models?

With Opus 4.8, I would spend like 5 rounds going through ideas before it finally suggested something in the right ballpark, which I would then have to rework entirely still. I never took a game design choice verbatim, everything needed major revisions. 

With Fable 5.1, I did take one minor game design idea without needing to really edit it.

With Opus 5.5, I've already taken 2 goated game design ideas that were staring me in the face this whole time, I just couldn't see them.

Has anybody else had this experience? There's a lot of discussion on how hard it is to teach a model taste, and whether taste will scale up, but it really does seem like the models are getting better at this stuff.
